title: A schema authoring the one value the codec rejects
description: The negative control for SchemaNullAbsenceTests, and it carries two of the guarded thing where only one is a finding. capacity's default is the JSON null value; mode's default is the four-character string "null", which is a legal string and must not be reported. layers puts a null inside an array inside an examples array, so the scan is held to every depth rather than to the top level of a subschema.
